facts.statement: The Selective frontal/planta path names exactly two layers, both private constants of LateralHeaderDrawer: "RACKCAD_ANOTACIONES" for text annotations and "RACKCAD_COTAS" for dimensions. StructuralSectionMaterializer, a separate non-Selective path, declares the same annotation layer name.

LayerHelper.EnsureLayer creates a layer only when it is missing. If LayerTable.Has(name) is true it returns the existing id and changes nothing (colour, on/off, freeze, lock are left as they are). Otherwise it creates a LayerTableRecord and sets only Name and Color = Color.FromColorIndex(ByAci, aci). It never sets linetype, lineweight, plottability, on/off/freeze/lock, transparency or description.
RACKCAD_ANOTACIONES is ensured with ACI 2 (yellow) and assigned to each DBText through EnsureAnnotationLayer. RACKCAD_COTAS is ensured with ACI 1 (red) and assigned to each RotatedDimension.

Layers are created lazily, never unconditionally. RACKCAD_ANOTACIONES is ensured only when an Annotation instance with non-blank text is materialized; blank text returns before the layer call. RACKCAD_COTAS is ensured only when a Dimension instance is materialized. SystemBlockWriter, ViewBlockDraw and BlockPlacement contain no layer code.

Layers are created inside the transaction that creates the view-block definition and are committed with it. If the jig placement is cancelled, BlockPlacement erases the unreferenced definition and purges its nested defs, but it does not remove any layer. A cancelled insert can therefore leave RACKCAD_ANOTACIONES or RACKCAD_COTAS in a drawing with no rack.

A redraw (RACKEDITAR or a variable propagation) erases all prior entities of the definition and repopulates it through the same AppendInstance, which re-ensures the layers if the toggles are on. No code removes a layer when the toggles are turned off.

Nested piece BlockReferences and header-group references are appended without a LayerId. The catalog row BlockCatalogEntry has Layer, Color, Scale and Rotation fields, but HeaderBlockInstance has no layer field and the drawer never applies a catalog layer or colour.
The layer that nested piece references actually get (no explicit LayerId) is decided by AutoCAD's default for a new entity, commonly the current layer. The Plugin never calls SetDatabaseDefaults.
facts.evidence: git grep 'SetDatabaseDefaults' in src/RackCad.Plugin at 3375aadb has no hits; src/RackCad.Plugin/Drawing/LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:308-314

facts.statement: Annotations are DBText, not MText. Height is instance.TextHeight when > 0, else 3.0. TextString is instance.Text and LayerId is RACKCAD_ANOTACIONES. HorizontalMode is TextCenter and VerticalMode is TextVerticalMid. Position and AlignmentPoint are both the anchor (Z=0), and AdjustAlignment(db) is called after the entity is appended.
The DBText gets no TextStyleId, Rotation, WidthFactor, Oblique, Color, Linetype or Lineweight. No text style is created or looked up anywhere in the Plugin.
facts.evidence: src/RackCad.Plugin/Drawing/LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:266-277; git grep 'TextStyleTable|TextStyleId|WidthFactor' in src/RackCad.Plugin at 3375aadb has no hits

facts.statement: The text style, rotation, width factor and colour that a new DBText actually gets are AutoCAD defaults for an entity with those properties unset. This is runtime behaviour and cannot be established from repo code.

Selective label sizing: base text height 6.0 in, Margin 4.0 in (not scaled), and TextHeightFor(scale) = 6 x scale, with scale <= 0 treated as 1. The resolver sets AnnotationScale to the design value when > 0, else 1. The rack-name label uses 1.5 x h. Each Label sets Insertion = ConnectionAnchor = anchor and Role = Annotation.

Frontal labels, with gap = h + 4: (a) NumberFronts puts one number per bay at (bay centre X, -(FrontalBottomReach + gap)), or at -gap when no frontal cotas are drawn. (b) NumberLevels puts one number per level of bay 0 at (postX[0] - gap, level.Y). (c) DrawRackName with a non-blank Name puts the name at (postX[0], Height + h), height 1.5h. The frontal Build returns nothing when Height <= 0 or there are no bays.

Planta labels: NumberFronts puts one number per bay at (-gap, mid-Y between consecutive frames). DrawRackName with a non-blank Name and at least one frente position puts the name at (0, last frente Y + gap), height 1.5h. NumberLevels is not used in planta.

Dimension geometry rule: the drawer creates a RotatedDimension with p1 = Insertion and p2 = ConnectionAnchor (Z=0). The dimension is horizontal when |p2.Y - p1.Y| <= |p2.X - p1.X|, and rotation is 0 (horizontal) or PI/2 (vertical). The dimension-line point is (midX, p1.Y + DimensionOffset) when horizontal and (p1.X + DimensionOffset, midY) when vertical. Dimension text is string.Empty and LayerId is RACKCAD_COTAS.

Dimension style: the named style (instance.DimensionStyleName = system.DimensionStyle) is used as-is, with no overrides, only when it is non-blank and DimStyleTable.Has(name). Otherwise db.Dimstyle (the drawing's current style) is used. No dimension style is ever created because the table is opened ForRead only. A named style missing from the drawing falls back to the current style without any message or log. The editor keeps a saved style name in its combo even when the current drawing lacks it.

Per-dimension DIMVAR overrides are applied only in automatic mode (no usable named style), with h = instance.TextHeight or 3.0: Dimscale=1.0, Dimtxt=h, Dimasz=0.7h, Dimexe=0.4h, Dimexo=0.4h, Dimgap=0.3h, Dimtad=1, Dimdec=2. RecomputeDimensionBlock(true) is always called afterwards. No other dimension property is set.

Selective dimension constants: ChainGap 14, OverallGap 22 and ElevationStep 14, all multiplied by scale. Dimension text height is h = 6 x scale. Offsets are always negative (below or left of the geometry): near = -14s, far = -36s, and Detailed elevation lines use -(36s + (i+1) x 14s). Zero-length segments (< 1e-6) are skipped.

Frontal cotas are gated by DimensionViewPolicy.EffectiveDetail(Dimensions, DimensionViews, Frontal) and require postX.Count >= 2 and Height > 0. Minimal draws the total height (vertical at the left post) and bay 0's larguero cut. Standard draws a per-bay larguero cut chain, the overall post-to-post width, the level-separation chain and the total height. Detailed adds each level's elevation.

Planta cotas are gated by EffectiveDetail(..., Planta) and require frenteYs.Count >= 2 and offsets non-empty. Minimal draws one representative larguero cut (Y) and the overall depth (X). Standard draws the cut per frente, the per-fondo depth chain and the overall depth. There is no Detailed-only branch, so Detailed draws the same as Standard in planta.
Annotation and Dimension instances always stay loose. They are appended directly into the top-level view-block definition, not into nested group definitions and not into model space.

The top-level reference is created by PlaceBlockWithJig as new BlockReference(Point3d.Origin, definitionId). The jig sets only Position. The reference is always appended to Model Space via GetBlockModelSpaceId, never to the current space. No LayerId, Rotation, ScaleFactors or colour is set.

The effective layer of the top-level reference is not set by RackCad code, so it is AutoCAD's default for a new entity, commonly the current layer (CLAYER) at placement. Repo code cannot confirm this, and no SetDatabaseDefaults call exists in the Plugin.
facts.evidence: src/RackCad.Plugin/Drawing/BlockPlacement.cs:182,193-196; git grep 'SetDatabaseDefaults|Clayer' in src/RackCad.Plugin has no hits

facts.statement: The view-block definition is created with Origin = Point3d.Origin and a unique name: the sanitized base name, with _1, _2, ... appended if the name is taken. The frontal base name is the rack name or "Selectivo", passed to RackViewBaseName.LinkedSelectiveFrontal.

ApplyDynamicParameters silently drops parameters the block does not expose. It returns at once when the reference is not a dynamic block or has no values. Otherwise it matches names case-insensitively and sets only properties that exist and are not ReadOnly. Plan parameters with no matching property, and all parameters of a non-dynamic block, are skipped with no log, message or missing entry. RecordGraphicsModified(true) runs only when at least one value was applied.

Only a piece whose block is absent from the block table, or whose block name is blank, is recorded as missing (once per block and view). On insert this is reported as "Bloques no definidos en el dibujo (omitidos)". Library import checks block names only, never parameters.
On the RACKEDITAR redraw path the missing-block list comes back in HeaderPlacementResult, but EditSelective only checks Success and never prints it.

All annotation and dimension toggles default to off. NumberFronts, NumberLevels and DrawRackName are plain bools (false), and Dimensions defaults to DimensionDetail.None. In the editor the three checkboxes have no IsChecked, and DimensionsBox.SelectedIndex = 0 ("Ninguna"). A Selective frontal or planta drawn with defaults emits no Annotation or Dimension instances, so this path creates neither RACKCAD layer.

A Selective frontal never creates RACKCAD_ANOTACIONES when NumberFronts is off (or there are no bays), NumberLevels is off, and DrawRackName is off or Name is blank. A planta never creates it when NumberFronts is off (or there are fewer than 2 frente positions) and DrawRackName is off or Name is blank. NumberLevels alone never creates it in planta.

RACKCAD_COTAS is not created for a view kind whose effective detail is None. That happens when Dimensions is None, or when DimensionViews is present and that kind's bit is off (Frontal=1, Lateral=2, Planta=4). It also happens when the builder guards fail (frontal: postX.Count < 2 or Height <= 0; planta: frenteYs.Count < 2 or no offsets). The policy is per view kind, so one view kind can have cotas while another has none.

The rack-name label depends on the runtime Name. Creation sets system.Name = name, and a blank or whitespace name suppresses the label even with DrawRackName on. The "Selectivo" fallback is applied only to the block name, not to the label.

Which layers a view needs is fully decided by its inputs: view kind, the toggles (copied unchanged into each fondo's frontal view by FondoSystemView), Name, bays/levels, and Dimensions plus DimensionViews. Re-running the same builders with the same authored design, the same Name and the same view kind emits the same Annotation/Dimension roles as the source's last draw. That draw already ensured those layers through LayerHelper, so no new layer is needed unless the layer was later removed or renamed outside RackCad.

From the builder code, a mirror using the same authored design could need a layer the source drawing lacks when its inputs differ from what was drawn. (a) View kind: a planta-only source with NumberLevels on, or with DimensionViews = Frontal only, has neither layer, but a frontal needs RACKCAD_ANOTACIONES or RACKCAD_COTAS. (b) Name: a source with a blank Name and DrawRackName on emits no label, while a named mirror would emit one and need RACKCAD_ANOTACIONES.

No mirror command is registered at 3375aadb. So it cannot be established whether a mirror would redraw through LateralHeaderDrawer, which would silently create any missing RACKCAD layer (ACI 2/1) via EnsureLayer, or would transform existing references and need no new layer.
facts.evidence: git grep 'CommandMethod(' in src/RackCad.Plugin at 3375aadb lists no mirror command (e.g. src/RackCad.Plugin/RackSelectivoCommands.cs:23,26); src/RackCad.Plugin/LayerHelper.cs:18-28

facts.statement: The same layers can come from paths other than Selective. LateralHeaderDrawer is shared by the view-block draw services (selective, dynamic, cama, cabecera planta) and the lateral service, and StructuralSectionMaterializer ensures RACKCAD_ANOTACIONES. A cancelled insert also leaves them (L5). So the presence of a layer does not prove that a Selective rack drew annotations or cotas.

Whether a user can PURGE, delete or RENAME a RACKCAD layer after a Selective rack drew entities on it (inside the block definition) is AutoCAD behaviour. The code has no guard or restore beyond re-creating the layer by name on the next draw or redraw.

Only two Named Objects Dictionary entries exist in the Plugin: RACKCAD_PROJECT (project-variable register) and RACKCAD_CUSTOM_PROPERTIES (project custom properties). NamedObjectsDictionaryId appears only in their two data classes. Both store one Xrecord of text chunks of at most 255 characters.

The Selective creation path neither reads nor writes either NOD entry. The path is RACKSELECTIVO, or the RACKCAD menu, then DrawSelectiveView, DrawSelectiveViewFromAuthored, InsertSelectiveFrontal or SelectivePlantaDrawService.DrawAndPlace, then ViewBlockDraw, SystemBlockWriter, BlockPlacement and LateralHeaderDrawer. On creation the window is never given project variables and starts with literal defaults.

facts.statement: Creation writes the rack payload to the extension dictionary of the view-block DEFINITION, not to the NOD. The key is RACKCAD_SELECTIVE and the value is an Xrecord of 255-character DxfCode.Text chunks. The payload is a RackEmbedDocument (kind Selective, id, name, view, section, design JSON). For a new rack the design document is built by SelectivePalletDesignDocument.From(design, id, name), which carries no bindings. RackBlockData's summary says "block reference's extension dictionary", but the code writes on the definition id.

RACKEDITAR (EditSelective) reads RACKCAD_PROJECT once, before the window opens, in ReadProjectVariables. It runs under the document lock in its own transaction, calls ProjectVariablesRegistry.Read, sweeps every rack envelope (RACKCAD_SELECTIVE Xrecords on non-layout, non-anonymous, non-xref definitions, with direct reference counts), and commits without writing anything.

EditSelective uses the register read in four ways. (a) SelectiveEditorOpen.Resolve blocks the editor when the register is PresentButUnreadable or IncompatibleMajor, is not accredited, or resolution fails; otherwise it opens on the effective design with variable values substituted for bound properties. (b) LinkedPropertyOptions.ForProperty(SelectiveVerticalClearance, registry) supplies the variable choices; if unusable the command returns. (c) LinkedPropertyReconciler.Reconcile accredits and resolves again; failure aborts before any redraw. (d) ApplyBinding. The only linkable properties are VerticalClearance and PalletTolerance.

A binding gesture (lines 94-100) goes through SelectiveBindingIntentPreflight.Run, then ProjectVariableMutationExecutor.Execute. Link and Unlink plans carry RegistryMutation.None. In its mutate transaction the executor re-reads RACKCAD_PROJECT and rescans envelopes only when Kind != None or PlanReadSet is non-empty. It writes RACKCAD_PROJECT via TryWrite only when Kind != None. It redraws every view of the rack, writing RACKCAD_SELECTIVE payloads, in that same transaction. So the Selective editor reads RACKCAD_PROJECT but never writes it.

RACKCAD_CUSTOM_PROPERTIES is reached only through CustomPropertiesExecutor, which only RackPropiedadesCommands (RACKPROPIEDADES) calls. Neither the Selective creation path nor the edit path touches it.

On redraw, geometry comes from the EFFECTIVE system: window.SystemToInsert in the editor, or SelectiveGeometryResolver.Resolve(rack.EffectiveOutput) in a propagation. The persisted payload is the AUTHORED document (reconciled.Authored, or rack.AuthoredOutput). The label Name comes from the window or embed, or from AuthoredOutput.Name.
Besides the NOD, the creation path reads only the DimStyleTable (read-only) to fill the style combo, and checks drawing units through RackUnitsGuard. Neither writes any dictionary.

limitations: Read-only static reading of source at commit 3375aadb. Nothing was built, run or tested, and AutoCAD was not started.

What AutoCAD assigns to properties the code leaves unset is runtime behaviour, not repo code, and is marked UNCERTAIN. This covers the layer, colour and text style of new entities with no LayerId or TextStyleId (including the top-level reference and nested pieces), the default linetype and lineweight of a new layer, and PURGE/RENAME behaviour.

The contents of blocks-library.dwg were not inspected. WblockCloneObjects (BlockLibraryImporter.cs:123) could bring in layers the library blocks use, and whether any of them are RACKCAD_* layers is unknown.
No mirror command exists at 3375aadb, so the mirror answer (S5-S7) is inferred from the shared builders and writers, not from mirror code.
The lateral (corte) view was covered only where it shares LateralHeaderDrawer; its builder was read only for the annotation toggles (SelectiveLateralBuilder.cs:589-623).
Docs, ADRs and HANDOFF were not consulted, as the task asked; all evidence is from src/ at 3375aadb.

missed.statement: A NEW Selective rack can start from a library template instead of the defaults. The path is RACKCAD menu, then SelectiveEditorModule.OpenFromLibrary, then window.LoadForNew, then LoadDesign. That loads NumberFronts, NumberLevels, DrawRackName, AnnotationScale, Dimensions, DimensionViews and DimensionStyle from the template. The first insert can therefore create RACKCAD_ANOTACIONES and RACKCAD_COTAS, and it can carry a named DimensionStyle that the current drawing lacks. SelectDimStyle adds that name to the combo, and at draw time ResolveDimStyle silently falls back to db.Dimstyle with automatic DIMVAR overrides.

A brand-new Selective created from the RACKCAD menu (OpenForNew) never calls SetDimensionStyles, so the style combo holds only '(Automático)'. Such a rack is always drawn in automatic DIMVAR-override mode unless the style is changed later in RACKEDITAR. RACKSELECTIVO does populate the drawing's styles.

Rack-scoped custom properties are not in the NOD. They live inside the RACKCAD_SELECTIVE envelope (RackEmbedDocument.CustomProperties) on the definition's extension dictionary, written by CustomPropertiesExecutor through RackBlockData.Write. The Selective creation and edit path carries them forward: RackEmbedComposer.Compose inherits source.CustomProperties. A fresh insert (source = null) writes none, while an edit redraw, or an 'Insertar' during edit (source = picked embed), inherits them.

The existing product copy mechanism, RACKDUPLICAR and RACKLAYOUT independent copies, is the closest precedent for a mirror. It clones the definition with Database.DeepCloneObjects inside the same database, sharing the nested ARRAY defs, so no layer is created. The new reference explicitly copies the source reference's LayerId. RackCloner also renames the DBText whose text equals the source rack name.

On a cancelled insert, EraseUnreferencedDefinition queues only nested BlockReference definitions for purge. It does not queue the anonymous *D blocks owned by the RotatedDimensions inside the erased definition. RedefineSystemBlock does queue Dimension.DimBlockId, so a cancelled insert with cotas can leave orphaned *D blocks as well as the RACKCAD layers.

Other RackCad materializers deliberately set Layer='0' with ByBlock colour, linetype and lineweight, because the repo states that a new entity is otherwise born on CLAYER. The Selective drawer does not do this for piece or header references, nor for the top-level reference.
After a cancelled placement, the insert message still says the block was 'creado, pero la insercion se cancelo', although the definition has been erased. Any RACKCAD layers it created remain.
